summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on computer vision experience spanning dataset curation and annotation, YOLO and PyTorch model training, and monocular depth estimation for 3D surface reconstruction. Trained U-Net segmentation on volumetric medical imaging, explored AR/VR perception through a mixed reality headset concept, and shipped a TensorRT-optimized YOLO pipeline for real-time visual servoing on a robotic pick-and-place system. Comfortable owning the full CV pipeline from raw data and annotation through deployed model.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying without a green screen; produced full claims documentation and BOM.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling with ±8% error on 3D surface reconstruction.
Designed a custom wavelet bank to suppress low-frequency noise, combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7 to 10.9 ms, 17.6 to 92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for real-time visual servoing, alongside dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.
Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter mobile client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Built automated data generation pipelines using CARLA's semantic segmentation and raycast occlusion filtering to produce ~5,000 YOLO and ~3,000 UFLD training frames with zero manual annotation.
Trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) with SoftmaxFocalLoss + ParsingRelationLoss; integrated into an adaptive control stack with lane-following and waypoint fallback.
Validated in Town02 with 30 vehicles and 10 pedestrians; achieved zero collisions and correct traffic light compliance across multiple laps.
